legend: This year, there have been unusually many UFO sightings reported. Nobody knows if they are caused by optical illusions, weather phenomena, or secret technology being tested by foreign powers (terrestrial or not). UFO enthusiasts across the world rejoice, and speculations run wild. But someone who is not impressed is the farmer Celeste. Her large grain field has repeatedly been used as a landing site by the UFOs, destroying her crops. Celeste would like to bring whoever is responsible to justice, but before she can do so she must assess the damage caused by the unidentified flying offenders.

In total n$$$n$$$ circular UFOs have landed in Celeste's field. The i$$$i$$$th one left a crop circle which destroyed all crops within radius ri$$$r_i$$$ of the point xi,yi$$$x_i, y_i$$$. The field is very large, so you can assume that it extends infinitely in all directions. Your task is to estimate the total area of crops destroyed by the UFOs. Celeste only needs a rough estimate of the true answer, and your answer will be counted as correct if its relative error is less than 10%$$$10\%$$$.
input: The first line of input contains one integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤10$$$1 \leq n \leq 10$$$), the number of UFOs. Then follow n$$$n$$$ lines, the i$$$i$$$th of which contains the three integers xi$$$x_i$$$, yi$$$y_i$$$, and ri$$$r_i$$$ (0≤xi,yi≤10$$$0 \leq x_i, y_i \leq 10$$$, 1≤ri≤10$$$1 \leq r_i \leq 10$$$), describing the crop circle left by the i$$$i$$$th UFO.
output: Output the total area covered by the crop circles in the input, with a relative error of at most 1/10$$$1/10$$$.

legend.ai: 今年，报告称目击不明飞行物的事件异常频繁。没有人知道这些事件是由视觉错觉、天气现象，还是外国势力（地球上的或非地球上的）正在测试的秘密技术所引起的。不明飞行物爱好者们在世界各地欢欣鼓舞，各种猜测甚嚣尘上。但农场主 Celeste 对此并不感兴趣。她大片的谷田一再被不明飞行物当作降落地点，导致她的庄稼被毁。Celeste 希望将责任人绳之以法，但在此之前，她必须先评估这些不明飞行物造成的损失。

总共有 n$$$n$$$ 个圆形 UFO 降落在 Celeste 的田地中。第 i$$$i$$$ 个 UFO 留下了一个麦田怪圈，以点 xi,yi$$$x_i, y_i$$$ 为圆心、半径为 ri$$$r_i$$$ 的范围内的所有作物都被摧毁。田地非常大，因此可以假设它向各个方向无限延伸。你的任务是估算 UFO 摧毁的作物总面积。Celeste 只需要真实答案的粗略估计，如果你的答案的相对误差小于 10%$$$10\%$$$，就会被判定为正确。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤10$$$1 \leq n \leq 10$$$)，表示 UFO 的数量。接下来有 n$$$n$$$ 行，其中第 i$$$i$$$ 行包含三个整数 xi$$$x_i$$$、yi$$$y_i$$$ 和 ri$$$r_i$$$(0≤xi,yi≤10$$$0 \leq x_i, y_i \leq 10$$$，1≤ri≤10$$$1 \leq r_i \leq 10$$$)，描述第 i$$$i$$$ 个 UFO 留下的麦田怪圈。

output.ai: 输出输入中麦田怪圈覆盖的总面积，相对误差不超过 1/10$$$1/10$$$。
